correctness.rationale: The exactly specified triangular RK tableau yields a rational-power stability function, with stage-transfer identity independently checked. Expanding the odd logarithm uniformly on bounded complex domains gives an explicit second-order perturbation. Taking the complex modulus after real damping leads to F(omega)-2 eta; strict positivity follows from |sin t|<|t|, and a nonzero derivative gives the unique local root. A log-product argument proves energy accumulation. verify.py executed 97 finite checks; finite checks do not establish the proof.

value.rationale: SSP-optimal stages are used for hyperbolic and advection semidiscretizations with imaginary or weakly damped Fourier spectra. The first nonvanishing oscillatory energy defect has an exact positive continuum profile, defining the minimum O(s^-2) damping to prevent growth; the sharp exp(TF) energy multiplier over O(s²) steps makes the effect observable. It complements but does not merely rename the existing real-axis stability threshold.
